rule: lowest t in [0.700, 0.995] (step 0.005) with Coffea disease-answer rate <= 5.0% AND otro rejection >= 98.0%, both on calibration data only

calibration_sets.coffea: 400 iNaturalist Coffea arabica photos (taxon 64342), one per observer, observers absent from reports/field_inat_attribution.csv (no overlap with the 399-photo Coffea test sample or any disease observer); reports/field_calib_attribution.csv
calibration_sets.otro: 267 validation-split otro images (PlantDoc other crops + Imagenette), not the test split
calibration_sets.field_pos: 60 field_train disease photos screened 'no' (symptom not clearly visible; never used to train v2; not in the field test; SAME observers as v2 training photos): cercospora 10, minador 6, roya 44
calibration_sets.jmuben_val: JMuBEN validation split (Kenyan close-ups), 300 per coffee class

recall_note: No clean field data is left for recall: every screened-yes field photo is either v2 training or field test. Recall on calibration is therefore NOT a field estimate; it is shown only to see the direction of the trade-off. The rule does not use it.

chosen.why_single: the phone app (app/infer.js) runs single view only; multicrop is swept for information and is not a ship candidate
